articles.summary: NEW YORK, May 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Lazard, Inc. (NYSE: LAZ) announced today that Michael Ure has joined the firm as a Senior Advisor in the Power, Energy & Infrastructure Group, based in Houston. Michael brings more than 20 years of experience in executive and investment roles.
